question: Should Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should the current inline autogrow plus configurable send shortcut remain the intended long-prompt path?
rationale: The requested workflow is missing and fits web-frontend ergonomics, but it adds a second composition mode with UX and state semantics that need maintainer direction before implementation.

options.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
options.body: Implement an explicit modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer
options.body: Treat the current autogrow textarea and modifier-send setting as the intended long-prompt solution, then close or narrow the request accordingly.

options.title: Defer UX Mode Choice
options.body: Keep the issue open but leave it out of repair automation until a Control UI owner chooses the editor shape.

recommendation.title: Approve Expanded Composer Modal
recommendation.body: Implement an explicit modal editor with Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, attachment handling, and modal-only Enter/Ctrl-or-Cmd+Enter behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the prior issue review and recently landed the adjacent Control UI composer shortcut preference, making them the best observed owner for this product-scope call.
